details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc carrying only host metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the working directory, and the npm/node version, tagged with an x-beacon-package header. The same beacon also fires when index.js is imported; index.js otherwise exports a no-op Proxy so that importing code does not crash. No credentials, tokens, environment values, or file contents are read or transmitted, and no other payload is downloaded or executed.
